title: MoonMail
summary: Browser mailbox for encrypted Ootle letters, recoverable Inbox/Sent and encrypted preferences; it does not send ordinary email. October 29 landing and privacy pages loaded. Sapient private-view access is a separate account-wide grant that can expose other resources’ private amounts and memos; spending still needs approval. Public postbox identities, signers, timing, fees and size buckets remain observable, and historical mailbox-key compromise has no forward-secrecy protection. Private payment requests use three approvals with non-atomic transfer and receipt delivery. Public/link gifts expose vault amounts and have no expiry or sender refund; complete private links grant bearer access. The README separates historical funded tests from current read-only recovery and local tests. The recording shows public privacy documentation, not mail delivery or a payment. MIT source; no wallet grant or transaction exercised.
cardSummary: Exchange encrypted letters between Ootle postboxes and recover conversations, sent mail and saved settings through Sapient.
creator: SealClubber
